notes: **Apples-to-apples with google-pytorch/torchtitan PR #122 (native lane, 16.23% MFU) and PR #123 (HF backend, 16.29% MFU):** same slice shape (`tpu7x-2x2x2` = v7x-8, `16` TensorCore ranks, SimpleFSDP over 16), same `seq_len=2048`, same global batch `512 x 2048 = 1,048,576` tok/step (`mb=32`, `ga=1`) unless a row says otherwise, same `c4_test` EoD packing as upstream (`C4-EoD`) unless marked `Full-Seq`, and the same MFU definition (TorchTitan counter `17.385` GFLOP/token = **PaLM GF/tok** column, `1,153.5` BF16 TFLOP/s per TensorCore).

Each run is `60` steps; the steady column averages steps `11..60`. The two PR-window columns re-score the same run with each PR's own window (PR #122: median of steps `3..8`; PR #123: mean of steps `2..10`).

`eng_*` rows reproduce the PR recipes verbatim with this repo's image; `abl_*` rows add one group of changes at a time; `ours_*` rows are the full recipe of this repo (`ours_05` also changes the batch, so it is not iso-batch).
